items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: Well he played on some of my albums and we did it but it wasn’t a big problem

ctx.x: When he heard something that he didn’t want to hear, he let everybody know, that wasn’t what I can do. And I always loved that. Well he played on some of my albums and we did it but it wasn’t a big problem, because it was a flaw. But it was an unusual way to treat it. I usually kept quiet, and then went up to the arranger or the producer and said maybe I can do something better, do you want to overdub?
How long was a typical session? Were they four hours?
